title: The Unfilled River of Phlegethon
survival_class: SURVIVAL DIFFICULTY CLASS 4 (Exit: 2/5 Somewhat Difficult to Exit; Environment: 4/5 Extreme Environmental Risk; Entities: 5/5 Hostile Infestation)
physical_identity: Endless WWI-style abandoned trench system with mud, sandbags, barbed wire, bunkers, gun emplacements and artillery stations.
scale_topology: Level spans infinitely but only the trench system is accessible; Euclidean, with random twists; outdoors in trenches; underground bunkers and tunnels.
anomalies: Unseen entities kill anyone leaving the trench
lighting_sound: Eerie silence broken by distant gunfire (reduced at night); fog, flood and storm; blue entity lights; lighting otherwise day/night.

entities.name: Entity 49/1 'Trenchcleaners'
entities.behavior: Patrols trenches; stalks movement, closes to line of sight, fires chaingun; stays in sections for long periods.

entities.name: Unseen entities beyond no man's land
entities.behavior: Shoot anyone leaving the trench; escalate to missiles, artillery; bombers rarely; identity unknown.

entities.name: Kingdom of Hagsten military
entities.behavior: Supposed shooters/creators of the Trenchcleaner; 'highly possible'.

entities.name: Republic of Nuvaria soldiers
entities.behavior: May once have inhabited the trenches; may not have existed.

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Trenchcleaners (49/1), unseen entities

entrances.method: enter an abandoned Humvee; lose consciousness and wake in the trench
entrances.quote: Entering an abandoned High Mobility Multipurpose Wheeled Vehicle (Humvee) in Level 35 causes you to lose consciousness
Touching a military recruitment poster in Level 11 triggers an immediate no-clip to this level

entrances.method: being buried alive, by accident or intent, then regain consciousness
entrances.quote: Being buried alive in any level

exits.conditions: found in all three bunkers of the M.E.G. Outpost Gutter Bunkers
exits.quote: Specific rusted doors in the bunkers serve as access points to Level 14, Level 65, or Level 50
Specific rusted doors in the bunkers serve as access points to Level 14, Level 65, or Level 50
Specific rusted doors in the bunkers serve as access points to Level 14, Level 65, or Level 50
Being struck by lightning during a rainstorm phenomenon results in an immediate no-clip to Level 3

exits.method: follow a water-filled tunnel opened by severe flooding
exits.quote: a water-filled tunnel may become accessible. Following this tunnel will lead you to Level 7

exits.method: killing another wanderer triggers an immediate no-clip
exits.conditions: kill a wanderer in this level
exits.quote: Killing another wanderer in this level will trigger an immediate no-clip to Level 666

signature_mechanic: Stay in the trench: the parapet is a lethal boundary enforced by unseen entities, while a Trenchcleaner stalks by heat and noise, weather shifts the risk and exits are hidden.
verticality: None above ground; bunkers and tunnels underground; exits through rusted bunker doors.
do_not: Do not allow leaving the trench; the page says it is invariably fatal and exits are not via the surface.
Do not give the unseen entities visible models; they are never seen.
Do not make the level a combat shooter; 'Fight back' is on the DON'T list.
Do not make the B.F.G. or M.E.G. outposts safe hubs with trade systems beyond the page; keep them minimal.
Do not treat Nuvaria/Hagsten as confirmed; they are hypotheses and in-universe documents.
Do not add Level 48 as an edge; it appears only in the link list.
Do not give a single canonical Trenchcleaner count; testimonies conflict.
content_warnings: Killing a wanderer as an exit trigger
conflicts_notes: Lancaster saw three machines; Falcon says only one exists. The article says 'only one known entity'. Page attributes the entrance list to 2016/07/18 but is edited 2026.
